caseNameFull: Aetna Health Inc., fka Aetna U. S. Healthcare Inc. v. Davila and CIGNA HealthCare of Texas, Inc., dba CIGNA Corp. v. Calad

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of American Association of Health Care Plans, Inc., et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 307 F. 3d 298.
